title: Medina Masonic Temple and Medina Theater, 120 North Elmwood Avenue, Medina, Medina County, OH
notes: Significance: The Medina Masonic Temple has been a cornerstone of town activity since 1924 as well as serving as a meeting place for the Fraternal Order of Free Masons Lodge No. 58. The Medina Masonic Temple was built in 1924 with plans prepared by Ridley and Glazier Architects in Akron, Ohio. The theater annex which was added later was designed by architect George Howard Burrows from Aurora, Ohio.
